rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2011).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2011 as 'Our Anniversary'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Moderate fragrance. Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form.
